name: unity-compile-on-save
description: By default, automatically set up Unity CLI/Pipeline, launch an installed Editor, and recompile scripts in trusted Unity workspaces. Includes CLI logs and C# Problems.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Automatic setup installs Unity CLI and modifies Unity package dependencies, then launches the Editor.

commands.title: Unity Compile on Save: Set Up / Reconnect Unity Pipeline
Unity Compile on Save: Recompile Unity

unityCompileOnSave.showConnectionStatus.description: Show Pipeline connection status and run background Unity CLI readiness queries every five seconds. Independent of Recompile on Save; disable this setting to stop status queries.

unityCompileOnSave.autoSetup.description: Enabled by default in trusted Unity-root workspaces when Recompile on Save is enabled: download/run Unity's installer if a supported CLI is missing, install Pipeline (modifying project package dependencies), and open the installed Editor if needed. Disable before opening/trusting the workspace to manage setup yourself; explicit setup still performs these actions.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnSave.description: Master switch for change-triggered recompilation and automatic CLI/Pipeline setup. Turning this off does not stop connection-status queries or explicit setup/recompile commands.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnSourceChan.description: Recompile when C# sources, assembly definitions, compiler options, or managed DLLs change. Only effective when Recompile on Save is enabled.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnProjectEnv.description: Refresh, resolve packages when needed, and recompile when package or scripting define settings change. Only effective when Recompile on Save is enabled.

unityCompileOnSave.quietPeriodSeconds.description: While recompilation is pending, wait this many seconds after the last change to any file in Assets, Packages, or ProjectSettings. Other files restart the wait without requesting recompilation themselves.

unityCompileOnSave.compileUnityOnSave.description: Legacy master switch; used only if Recompile on Save has not been explicitly configured.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
